result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 3 against AC-6.1 through AC-6.3, the replay harness, fixture loaders, replay tests, supporting capture path, current artifacts, and configured gates. The replay mechanics and gates pass, but the required recorded PI corpus proof is still missing because the fixture substrate uses synthetic stand-ins and inferred lifecycle.

newFindings.title: Replay fixtures are synthetic flat messages, not recorded PI hook corpora
newFindings.evidence: Story 3 requires replaying recorded PI corpora and states M0 corpora are fixture inputs (`stories/03-capture-verification.md:6`, `:13`, `:24`, `:28`, `:33`). The fixture contract says `test/fixtures/corpus.ts` should load M0 captures, while synthetic builders are for lifecycle and turn-derivation tests (`tech-design.md:557-560`). Current `packages/pi-lhc/test/fixtures/corpus.ts:1-4` states the loaders build synthetic stand-ins until M0 delivers recordings, and each named loader constructs `source` from `makeUserMessage` / `makeAssistantMessage` / `makeToolResult` rather than loaded recorded hook events (`corpus.ts:21-29`, `:42-53`, `:69-83`, `:97-105`, `:118-124`). The replay harness type is `source: AgentMessage[]` (`src/verify/replay.ts:39-42`) and it reconstructs lifecycle by inferring `agent_end` before a fresh user prompt and stamping synthetic entry IDs (`src/verify/replay.ts:111-147`). A filesystem search found no recorded corpus artifacts beyond `packages/pi-lhc/test/fixtures/corpus.ts` and `corpus.test.ts`.

verified: TC-6.1 mechanical replay path for current loaders: `replayCorpus` drives `mapMessage` -> `TurnAccumulator` -> `capture`, then compares durable events, `messages.listMessages`, and `turns.listTurns` (`src/verify/replay.ts:117-152`, `:432-457`).
TC-6.2 mechanical determinism for current loaders: replay tests compare two fresh-thread logical event read-backs and same-thread re-replay dedup behavior (`test/verify/replay.test.ts:96-129`).
TC-6.3 inspect surfaces: replay tests assert overview counts, last event position, failed derivations, and a capture gap visible through health (`test/verify/replay.test.ts:132-200`).
Fixture-validity risk test for current fixtures: `validateCorpus` checks event shapes, tool-result correlation, closed turn, and rejects `makeTruncatedCorpus` (`test/fixtures/corpus.test.ts`).
unverified: AC-6.1 / TC-6.1 recorded PI corpus input: current named corpora are synthetic stand-ins, not M0 recorded PI captures.
AC-6.2 / TC-6.2 deterministic replay over recorded corpora: determinism is proven only over synthetic `AgentMessage[]` fixtures with inferred lifecycle.
Definition of Done: fixture replay for all available M0 corpora is not established because no M0 recorded corpus artifacts are loaded.

productionPathFindings: F-03-001: Story 3's verification proof path still relies on synthetic fixture stand-ins and inferred lifecycle rather than recorded PI hook corpus fixtures.
openQuestions: Are the M0 recorded PI corpus artifacts available outside the current workspace? They are not present in the repository paths inspected.
additionalObservations: The previous shallow compare concern is closed in the current code: `replayCorpus` now reads and compares `messages.listMessages` and `turns.listTurns`, not only event counts or overview counts.
No Story 3 runtime path was found that serves context to a model; the replay provider fails closed and health assertions verify failed derivations are visible.
